slides.title: Cloud Ecosystem & Security
slides.description: Production-grade full-stack architecture: React 19 and Vite on Vercel, modular NestJS 11 and Fastify on Railway, Supabase PostgreSQL with Row Level Security (RLS), and Sentry observability.

slides.title: Admin Dashboard & Schedule Control
slides.description: Comprehensive administrative dashboard featuring an interactive booking calendar, full appointment CRUD, maintenance day and slot blocking, and JWT-secured route guards.

slides.title: Smart Booking & Real-Time Slots
slides.description: Step-by-step booking workflow with real-time slot availability, robust schema validation via Zod and React Hook Form, and automated booking confirmations delivered via Resend API.

cards.title: Vstah AI
cards.description: Mobile-first AI ERP OS with Zero-Knowledge privacy architecture. Bridges voice commands, computer vision, and structured ERP systems like 1C:Enterprise, SAP, and Odoo.

slides.title: Voice-First ERP Operations
slides.description: Hands-free inventory checks, order creation, and stock queries powered by Whisper audio transcription and LLM function calling.

slides.title: Real-Time Analytics & Vision AI
slides.description: Automated document processing via GPT-4o Vision for price tags and invoices, paired with real-time revenue and sales performance metrics.

slides.title: Zero-Knowledge Privacy & Connectors
slides.description: On-device JWE encryption, Qdrant vector RAG knowledge base, and universal connectors for 1C:Enterprise, SAP, and Odoo via OpenAPI and OData.

slides.title: Secure Auth & Offline-First Core
slides.description: Local SQLite storage ensuring uninterrupted offline operations, Supabase social authentication, and Guardian Guard pre-execution verification.

cards.title: FlowBrief-Power

slides.title: Custom RFQ Flow & Specification Engine
slides.description: Replaces standard retail carts with an enterprise Request-for-Quote (RFQ) pipeline, enabling engineering teams to specify technical parameters, custom configurations, and factory tooling requirements.

slides.title: Interactive 3D Machinery & SEO Catalog
slides.description: Interactive 3D equipment inspection powered by React Three Fiber, high-performance server-side parametric filtering, and automated SEO-first JSON-LD metadata generation.

slides.title: Next.js 16 Architecture & Multilingual i18n
slides.description: High-performance stack built with Next.js 16 App Router, Bun runtime, Tailwind CSS 4, and TypeScript. Full trilingual localization (EN, UK, RU) via next-intl, TanStack Query v5, and Zustand.

cards.title: FlowBrief
cards.description: Modern business survey platform built on Next.js 15, TypeScript, and Supabase. Streamlines client onboarding and requirements gathering through step-by-step questionnaires, personal dashboards, and AI assistance.

slides.title: FlowBrief — Business Survey System
slides.description: Modern web platform designed to streamline client requirements gathering, accelerate information intake, and enhance collaboration through guided, step-by-step interactive surveys with real-time progress tracking.

slides.title: Client Dashboards & AI-Assisted Responses

slides.title: Supabase Backend & Cloudflare Protection
slides.description: Robust backend powered by Supabase PostgreSQL and Supabase Auth, protected against automated abuse via Cloudflare Turnstile CAPTCHA, with transactional email delivery integrated through Resend API.

slides.title: Next.js 15 Architecture & Strict DX Pipeline
slides.description: Engineered with Next.js 15 App Router, TypeScript, TailwindCSS, and Radix UI. Features strict Node 22 NVM locking, Zod validation, next-intl i18n, Husky pre-commit hooks, and Lighthouse CI performance auditing.

cards.title: Church Voskresenie

slides.title: Church Voskresenie — Community Hub
slides.description: Modern multilingual platform for the Duisburg church community, engineered with Astro, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS v4 for ultra-fast static performance, minimal JavaScript payload, and seamless content delivery.

slides.title: Zero-Tracking Privacy & 2-Click Embeds
slides.description: Rigorous privacy compliance: custom 2-Click facades for YouTube videos and Google Maps that block third-party trackers until user interaction, paired with 100% self-hosted local fonts without external CDNs.

slides.title: Bilingual Routing & Type-Safe Content
slides.description: Comprehensive information architecture with parallel RU and DE routes, structured markdown pages, type-safe i18n dictionaries, and automated JSON-LD schema generation for search engine optimization.

slides.title: Sonar-Grade Quality & Modern DX
slides.description: Strict engineering standards: ESLint with eslint-plugin-sonarjs enforcing max 20-line functions, Lefthook pre-commit hooks (lint, format, astro check), Lenis smooth scrolling, and GSAP micro-animations.

cards.title: Sweet Tooth
cards.description: Interactive pastry and confectionery web application built with Vue 3, TypeScript, and Vite. Features high-performance GSAP ScrollTrigger timeline animations, 3D canvas frame sequences, and responsive Tailwind styling.

slides.title: Sweet Tooth — Interactive Confectionery
slides.description: Modern culinary showcase engineered with Vue 3 Composition API, TypeScript, and Vite. Delivers a tactile digital storefront featuring smooth scroll choreography and custom branding aesthetics.

slides.title: Canvas Frame Sequences & 3D Scroll Scrubbing
slides.description: Hero section powered by HTML5 Canvas and transparent PNG frame sequences, smoothly scrubbed via GSAP ScrollTrigger to produce interactive 3D product rotations synchronized with user scrolling.

slides.title: Pinned Product Showcase & Stagger Effects
slides.description: Section pinning mechanisms for product discovery with synchronized 360-degree item rotation, cascaded stagger entrances, and performance-tuned lazy loading for multi-frame animation assets.

slides.title: High-Performance Vite & Bun Pipeline
slides.description: High-speed developer experience using Bun runtime, Tailwind CSS typography tokens, Husky git pre-commit automation, strict TypeScript typing, and optimized production builds deployed on Vercel.
